title: Unpacking the Interdependent Systems of Discrimination: Ableist Bias in NLP Systems through an Intersectional Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Fill-in-the-blank sentence completion using pre-trained BERT with disability referents, evaluated via sentiment analysis and topic modeling of the predicted words.
Intersectional analysis combining gender referents with disability and race referents in template sentences, evaluated via sentiment analysis and topic modeling of BERT's predicted words.
Intersectional analysis combining race referents with disability and gender referents in template sentences, evaluated via sentiment analysis and topic modeling of BERT's predicted words.
